cohortScope.boundaryScope: embeddable Flutter editor SDKs on the same Flutter and Mac product stack; not a global Markdown-app market ranking
selectionRationale: Flutter Quill represents an established delta-backed embeddable rich-text architecture.
SuperEditor represents an established document/node-backed embeddable editing architecture.
Both use the same Flutter platform-input and rendering layers Flark must outperform without adding an unrelated app database, sync engine, or shell.

excludedHistoricalProbe.reason: The preserved Flutter 3.41.9 attempt did not compile, so no local measurement exists.

cohortSelectionSnapshot.authority: official pub.dev package pages and /api/packages/<package>/score endpoints
cohortSelectionSnapshot.criterion: From the frozen eligible candidate denominator, select the two highest cumulative pub.dev likeCount values. Record 30-day downloads and pub points as context but do not use them to change the selector after observation.
eligibility: embeddable editable multi-block document surface implemented in Flutter rather than a WebView
document content can be loaded and exported through a package API
declared or documented support includes macOS, Android, and iOS
package/project was publicly available at the retrieval timestamp
cohortSelectionSnapshot.candidateSearchScope: pub.dev Flutter packages described and tagged as editor, rich-text-editor, WYSIWYG, or document editor; WebView wrappers, renderer-only packages, full app shells, and pre-1.0 experimental packages with fewer than 10 likes were excluded

candidates.runnerRevisionPolicy: The benchmark pins the newer project dev revision recorded separately in macFirstProtocol.

candidates.executionNote: The preserved Flutter 3.41.9 local attempt did not compile; it remains in the selection denominator rather than disappearing.

cohortSelectionSnapshot.leadingClaimScope: top two by the frozen cumulative-like criterion within the eligible embeddable native-Flutter editor-SDK denominator; no global Markdown-app or performance leadership claim

limitations: The preserved numbers are debug flutter_test VM stopwatch timings, not profile-mode application input-to-paint timings.
The historical machine, macOS version, display refresh rate, repository commit, raw samples, minimums, maximums, and memory traces were not preserved with the result table.

The large-document labels use decimal target character counts of 100000 and 1000000; they are not exact 100 KiB or 1 MiB UTF-8 fixtures, and the final generated character counts were not preserved in the table.
The harnesses mutate editor controllers directly and time model work or tester.pump; they do not traverse the platform text-input path.
The fixtures are generated plain text, so the results do not establish Markdown source fidelity or semantic parity.
flutter_quill used an untracked lockfile and a caret dependency constraint, so the exact resolved package graph is unavailable.
super_editor was pinned to a git revision, but the documented Flutter compatibility edit was made in cache without a preserved patch or source-tree hash.
Median and p95 are preserved; p90, p99, and max are not recoverable from the narrative table.

fixture.adapterPolicy: Feed the same exact generated bytes to an unmodified default editor through the thinnest documented import adapter; record any byte or line-ending change on export as a fidelity failure.
fixture.semanticScope: plain-source fidelity and editor behavior only; no peer Markdown-semantic equivalence is claimed

workloads.start: profile process launch and fixture selection
workloads.end: first rasterized, interactive viewport containing exact expected source text

workloads.inputPath: focused Flutter platform text-input channel; direct controller mutation is forbidden
workloads.end: the rasterized frame containing each accepted character
the rasterized frame containing the exact post-edit text
the rasterized frame containing the complete exact pasted text

runControl.order: rotate competitor and size order across three runs using a recorded Latin square
runControl.machine: one named physical Mac, plugged into power, Low Power Mode off
runControl.isolation: no concurrent build, test, benchmark, screen recording, or indexing workload; idle five minutes before each run group
runControl.dependencyPinning: preserve pubspec.lock, flutter pub deps output, package source revisions, and any compatibility patch as hashed receipt artifacts
runControl.artifactPinning: hash the profile app, fixture, runner source, lockfile, raw timeline, stdout, and exported final source

requiredRecordedFields: repository commit and dirty diff hash
competitor package version, source revision, lockfile hash, and patch hash
exact command, cwd, environment, and runner source hash
machine model, CPU, core count, memory, macOS, power and thermal state
Flutter and Dart versions and revisions, Xcode version, build artifact hash
display refresh rate, device pixel ratio, and editor viewport
fixture generator, target bytes, actual bytes, SHA-256, line endings, and exported-source SHA-256
warmups, sample count, run count, order, cadence, timeouts, failures, and raw artifact hashes
p50, p90, p99, and max for open-to-paint and input-to-paint
build, raster, longest synchronous span, missed frames, backlog, and peak and retained RSS
crash, hang, timeout, input loss, source-fidelity, and final backlog outcomes

required: all fixture bytes are accepted or any normalization is explicitly reported
the first exact interactive viewport paints before the declared liveness timeout
every accepted typed, local-edit, and paste input becomes visible and exportable without loss
the workload reaches zero input backlog before timeout
the app does not crash, hang, or exceed available memory
comparableCompletion.note: Completion determines the separate competitor envelope; observed peer latency is recorded, not adopted as a Flark threshold.

targetPolicy.rule: Report the largest comparable competitor completion tier separately. Never relabel that boundary as Flark's 10 MiB target and never reduce the fixed 10 MiB tier because a peer fails earlier.
